description: Static data used by BYTM at runtime, including domain definitions, alerts, and DOM selector mappings.

formatVersion.description: Format version for future compatibility checks.

domains.description: List of supported domains, used for resolving hostnames to domain identifiers.

items.description: A supported domain with a unique identifier and its associated hostnames.

id.description: Unique short identifier of the domain. Can be "ytm" or "yt".

name.description: Full name of the domain, e.g. "YouTube Music".

nameShort.description: Short name of the domain, e.g. "YT Music".

hostnames.description: List of hostnames that map to this domain identifier.

alerts.description: List of alerts to potentially display to users. May be empty.

items.description: An alert that may be shown to users matching the specified criteria.

title.description: Localized title strings. "en-US" is required; other locales are optional.

^[a-z]{2}-[A-Z]{2,}$.description: Title in the given locale, as defined in `locales.json`.

message.description: Localized message strings. Supports Markdown. "en-US" is required; other locales are optional.

en-US.description: Message in English (United States). Required. Supports Markdown.

^[a-z]{2}-[A-Z]{2,}$.description: Message in the given locale. Supports Markdown.

important.description: If true, Escape and background-click don't close the dialog, and there'll be a short timer before the user can dismiss the alert. Defaults to false.

domains.description: List of domain identifiers on which the alert should be shown. If dismissed on one domain, it will be dismissed on all domains.

versionMin.description: Optional minimum BYTM version (inclusive) for which this alert applies. Must be a valid semver string.

versionMax.description: Optional maximum BYTM version (inclusive) for which this alert applies. Must be a valid semver string.

version.description: Optional exact BYTM version for which this alert applies. Must be a valid semver string. If this is specified, versionMin and versionMax are ignored.

dateMin.description: Optional earliest date (inclusive) for which this alert applies. Must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time string.

dateMax.description: Optional latest date (inclusive) for which this alert applies. Must be a valid ISO 8601 date-time string.

selectors.description: Mapping of selector identifiers to selector groups and per-domain selector strings.

anyOf.description: DOM selector strings for each domains supported by BYTM, keyed by domain identifier (can be "ytm" or "yt").
DOM selector string for all domains supported by BYTM.
